{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.48

|gr1= Mission Information

|descr= Returns the engine calculated size (terrain side length) of the current world in meters. In Arma, terrains are always square. ([[BIS_fnc_mapSize]] may return the same value, but is just a simple look up in [[configFile | config]]).

|s1= [[worldSize]]

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>private _size = worldSize; // VR and Stratis: 8192; Altis: 30720</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>
// A round marker that should cover the whole map, placed in the center of the map, should have the following radius (a, b)
private _radius = sqrt 2 / 2 * worldSize;
</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>
private _axis = worldSize / 2;
private _center = [_axis, _axis , 0];
private _radius = sqrt 2 * _axis;
</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_mapSize]] [[getTerrainInfo]]
}}
